summary: Completed comprehensive testing of D-Billet ticketing platform. All 26 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing shows all major features working correctly including dark theme, Train/Ferry booking with correct business logic, authentication, and admin dashboard. One UI issue identified: fixed bottom bar on event detail page overlaps with navigation bar.

ui_bugs.issue: Fixed bottom bar with Add to Cart/Buy Now buttons overlaps with bottom navigation bar. The fixed bar is positioned at bottom-20 on mobile but the navigation bar intercepts pointer events.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend APIs working correctly. Train booking uses day-based logic (even days=Nagad departures, odd days=Ali-Sabieh departures, 1st=holiday). Ferry uses weekday-based logic (Mon=no service, Tue/Thu/Fri/Sat=Tadjoura, Sun/Wed=Obock). Payment methods (Waafi, D-Money, CAC Bank) are MOCKED simulations.
